# Price-estimation experiment — results (auto-generated by src/experiment.py)

Scope: **new-car ex-showroom price**. Not validated for used-car resale. Target log1p(price); every metric is on the rupee scale. All numbers below are produced by the run, nothing hand-edited.

Data: 1276 rows. Dev 985 rows / 176 groups; held-out test 291 rows / 45 groups (seed 42). Exact duplicates removed from training and scoring. CV = 5 folds, group-aware (family_group). Inner tuning = GroupKFold(3) inside each training set.
